electronics-browse.title: Electronics Browse
electronics-browse.description: Baseline catalog retrieval with no filters to compare raw browse performance.
electronics-browse.notes: Uses the same electronics list endpoints already wired into the application UI. Set K6_PEAK_USERS to increase concurrency.

electronics-browse-20vu.title: Electronics Browse (20 users)
electronics-browse-20vu.description: Higher-concurrency electronics browse run to compare raw list retrieval under heavier traffic.
electronics-browse-20vu.notes: Use K6_PEAK_USERS=20 to reproduce this heavier browse scenario.

electronics-browse-100vu.title: Electronics Browse (100 users)
electronics-browse-100vu.description: Heavy-load electronics browse run for a clear scaling comparison.
electronics-browse-100vu.notes: Use K6_PEAK_USERS=100 to reproduce this 100-user browse scenario.

electronics-search.title: Electronics Search
electronics-search.description: Global-search query against the electronics data set to compare filtered search latency.
electronics-search.notes: Set K6_ELECTRONICS_QUERY to swap the search term for your own product keyword, and K6_PEAK_USERS to increase concurrency.

electronics-search-samsung-20vu.title: Electronics Search (samsung, 20 users)
electronics-search-samsung-20vu.description: Higher-concurrency electronics search run for the samsung keyword.
electronics-search-samsung-20vu.notes: Use K6_ELECTRONICS_QUERY=samsung and K6_PEAK_USERS=20 to reproduce this search scenario.

electronics-search-phone-100vu.title: Electronics Search (phone, 100 users)
electronics-search-phone-100vu.description: Heavy-load electronics search run for the phone keyword.
electronics-search-phone-100vu.notes: Use K6_ELECTRONICS_QUERY=phone and K6_PEAK_USERS=100 to reproduce this 100-user search scenario.

hm-fashion-browse-2vu.title: H&M Fashion Browse (2 users)
hm-fashion-browse-2vu.description: Baseline H&M browse view with no filters to compare flat-catalog retrieval performance.
hm-fashion-browse-2vu.notes: Use K6_PEAK_USERS to regenerate this H&M browse scenario for a different concurrency level.

hm-fashion-browse-5vu.title: H&M Fashion Browse (5 users)
hm-fashion-browse-5vu.description: Moderate-concurrency H&M browse run to compare flat-catalog retrieval performance.

hm-fashion-browse-100vu.title: H&M Fashion Browse (100 users)

hm-fashion-browse-100vu.notes: Use K6_PEAK_USERS=100 to reproduce this 100-user H&M browse scenario.

hm-fashion-search-dress-2vu.title: H&M Fashion Search (dress, 2 users)
